verdict.rationale: A probe confirms https://cal.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a curated product summary aimed at evaluators. Docs pages are served as .md, each pointing to a documentation index at cal.com/docs/llms.txt. A dedicated agents.md page explains how AI agents should check availability, book and use the CLI. Missing for 10: no direct probe of the docs-level llms.txt index itself, and no independent report of an agent actually consuming these files.
